articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into a free AWS GovCloud buffet for anyone with eyeballs. Nothing says "cybersecurity leadership" like yeeting your crown jewels into a public repo.
